notes:
V4.0.1 — three asks from V4.0.0 testing.

🔄  CHECK FOR UPDATES (bottom of Tools)
• New STAY UPDATED card at the very bottom of the Tools tab with a big ⟳ CHECK FOR UPDATES NOW button. Auto-update banner sometimes doesn't fire on a transient network blip — this gives you a deterministic way to confirm you're on the latest.

📜  TERMS & CONDITIONS
• New apex_settings users.accepted_tos_at column. On launch the desktop hits GET /auth/tos; if the user hasn't accepted the current version (v1.0), a modal blocks the UI until they explicitly click 'I Accept' (or 'Decline & sign out' which logs them out).
• T&C text written for the V4.0.0.txt liability clause: "app/creators not liable for losses except for the sale itself when a bot is moderated". Full text: 9 numbered sections covering as-is service, assumption of risk, no-liability rule, moderation refund exception, credits convention, publisher obligations, account termination, privacy, governing law.
• Public web page at /web/tos rendering the same text.
• Endpoints: GET /auth/tos (returns text + acceptance state) + POST /auth/tos/accept (records timestamp).

🌐  WEBSITE UPDATES
• Logo on every public page (landing, login, signup, dashboard, T&C) is now an <a href="/"> — clicking the ◈ BAPTOU mark anywhere takes you home.
• Cookie banner pinned to the bottom of every page on first visit. Explains the single apex_token auth cookie + links to the T&C. Dismisses with localStorage flag so it doesn't re-appear.
• Sticky footer with 'BAPTOU TRADING PLATFORM · TERMS & CONDITIONS · © 2026'.
• Most user-facing 'APEX' strings in templates → 'BAPTOU' (GitHub URL + internal docstrings unchanged so the auto-update / installer-download URL still works).
